title: 4-Layer Isomorphic Transcript Data Engine with Granularity Subscriptions

claims.assertion: Transcript streaming systems should separate normalized storage (L1), idempotent state operations (L2), granularity-gated event filtering (L3), and framework-free view projection (L4) to deliver zero-overhead telemetry across diverse UI consumers

context: Agent UI interfaces (CLI, Web, IDE sidecar) require different levels of detail from the execution stream: some need raw streaming token deltas, others need completed tool blocks, while background evaluators only need turn summaries.
distilled_learning: Implement a 4-layer isomorphic transcript architecture: 1) L1 Store (agent-granular normalized in-memory record of frames and turns), 2) L2 Operations (idempotent delta ops and turn-cursor pagination), 3) L3 Subscriptions (granularity-gated filtering supporting 'off' | 'turn' | 'block' | 'delta'), and 4) L4 View Registry (pure TypeScript view renderers completely decoupled from the agent runtime engine). Consumers declare their required granularity upon subscription, eliminating redundant serialization and frontend rendering churn.
